description: Unofficial Tsurumaru Kuninaga fan-art companion inspired by the standard Touken Ranbu white layered outfit. Original animation features a paper flower revealed from a sleeve, playful hood peeking beside a small foam screen and gentle shoulder-chain adjustment. The sword is omitted. Nine states include independent right, left and front runs plus a soft two-foot hop. No endorsement implied.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
